text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma. The ultrasound findings of a cystic mass in the subhepatic region combined with significant intra- and extrahepatic bile duct dilation, along with your symptoms of obstructive jaundice and weight loss, are highly suggestive of a malignant biliary obstruction, likely a Klatskin tumor or distal cholangiocarcinoma.
